title: EASM Insights Overview and Assets Overview dashboards: widgets, time frames and bucket definitions

prose.text: The findings behind the Insights widgets are in [[easm.findings]], the lookalike alert is in [[easm.lookalike-domains]] and the assets are in [[easm.assets]].

checks.do: Which dashboard the question is about and which organization is selected in the top-right corner.
Which SSL and TLS versions the Distribution of SSL/TLS Versions widget tests before reading a version as absent.

two-dashboards.statement: EASM has two dashboards: Assets Overview and Insights Overview, the latter covering the vulnerabilities and risks associated with the assets.

quotes: EASM provides two dynamic and interactive dashboards, namely Assets Overview and Insights Overview.
while the Insights Overview dashboard provides information on the vulnerabilities and risks associated with those assets.

org-selector-timestamp.statement: The Insights Overview dashboard shows data for the organization selected in the top-right corner and shows the timestamp when the displayed data was last updated.

quotes: The information consolidated on the dashboard corresponds to your organization selected in the top-right corner.
You can also see the timestamp when the current data displayed on the dashboard has been updated.

insights-widgets.statement: The Insights Overview dashboard has widgets for Top 5 Findings by ROI, risk-level distribution, findings over time, category percentage, top lookalike domains, top exposed VPN appliances, top locations, top findings by risk level, exposed sensitive services, SSL/TLS certificate expiration and domain registration expiration.

quotes: Top 5 Findings by ROI
Distribution of Findings by Risk Level
Findings Over Time by Risk Level
Findings Percentage by Category
Top 5 Lookalike Domains by Exposure
Top 5 Exposed VPN Appliances
Top Locations by Findings
Top 5 Findings by Risk Level
Exposed Sensitive Services
SSL/TLS Certificate Expiration
Domain Registration Expiration

trend-time-frames.statement: The Findings Over Time by Risk Level trend can be set to the last 7, 30, 90 or 180 days, with multiple risk levels selectable together.

quotes: from last 7 days, last 30 days, last 90 days, and last 180 days.
You can select multiple risk levels simultaneously to view the corresponding trends together.

trend-assets-time-frames.statement: The Assets Over Time by Risk Level trend can be set to the last 7, 30, 90 or 180 days, with multiple risk levels selectable together.

quotes: from last 7 days, last 30 days, last 90 days, and last 180 days.
You can select multiple risk levels simultaneously to view the corresponding trends together.

trend-daily-hover.statement: On the Findings Over Time by Risk Level graph, hovering shows the findings count for specific days when the time frame is greater than the last 7 days.

quotes: When customizing the graph for a time frame greater than the last 7 days, you can view the findings count for specific days by hovering over the line to the specific day.

top5-roi-widget.statement: The Top 5 Findings by ROI widget lists the top 5 findings by ROI score with Finding Name, ROI on a scale of 1 to 10, and Impacted Assets.

quotes: This widget provides a list of the top 5 risk findings for an organization that have the highest Return on Investment (ROI) score.
ROI: The ROI score calculated for the finding, on a scale of 1 to 10
Impacted Assets: The number of assets that are affected by this finding.
Finding Name: The name of the risk finding.

risk-level-widget.statement: The Distribution of Findings by Risk Level widget covers the levels low, medium, high and critical.

quotes: This widget provides information on how risk findings are distributed across risk levels such as low, medium, high, and critical.

lookalike-widget.statement: The Top 5 Lookalike Domains by Exposure widget ranks by exposure score and shows Original Domain, Lookalike Domain, Risk Category and Exposure Score.

quotes: Original Domain: The legitimate domain linked to your organization for which a lookalike domain has been identified.
Exposure Score: The risk score computed for the lookalike domain.
This widget provides the list of top 5 lookalike domains linked to the legitimate domains of your organization based on their exposure score.
Lookalike Domain: The lookalike domain identified based on your original domain linked to your organization.
Risk Category: The category assigned to the lookalike domain from Verified Phishing, Registered Lookalike, and Preventative Lookalike.

vpn-widget.statement: The Top 5 Exposed VPN Appliances widget shows the top 5 by risk score, with Known Exploits as a Boolean for the CISA KEV catalog and the CVE IDs identified in the appliance.

quotes: This widget provides the list of the top 5 exposed VPN appliances linked to your organization with the highest risk scores.
Known Exploits: A Boolean value that indicates if the vulnerability identified in the appliance is recognized in the Known Exploited Vulnerabilities (KEV) Catalog maintained by the CISA.
CVE: The CVE IDs of any publicly known vulnerabilities that are identified in the appliance.

sensitive-services-widget.statement: The Insights Overview widget Exposed Sensitive Services gives examples of SSH, FTP, Telnet, VNC, TFTP (UDP), SNMP (UDP), databases such as MySQL, MongoDB and Redis, and Elasticsearch.

quotes: Examples of sensitive services include SSH, FTP, Telnet, VNC, TFTP (UDP), SNMP (UDP), databases such as MySQL, MongoDB and Redis, and other services such as Elasticsearch.
- Exposed Sensitive Services

cert-expiration-buckets.statement: The SSL/TLS Certificate Expiration widget counts certificates that are already expired, expiring in the next 30 days, and with validity longer than the next 30 days.

quotes: SSL/TLS Certificate Expiration
this widget provides a count breakdown for the following:
Certificates that are already expired
Certificates expiring in the next 30 days
Certificates with a validity period longer than the next 30 days

domain-expiration-buckets.statement: The Domain Registration Expiration widget counts domains that are already expired, expiring in the next 30 days, with validity longer than the next 30 days, and with unknown validity.

quotes: Domains that are already expired
Domains expiring in the next 30 days
Domains with a validity period longer than the next 30 days
Domains for which the validity period is unknown

assets-widgets.statement: The Assets Overview dashboard widgets are Asset Count by Type, Assets by Risk Level, Assets Over Time by Risk Level, Top Locations by Assets, Top 5 Assets by Revealing Hostnames, Top 5 Assets by Risk Level and Distribution of SSL/TLS Versions.

quotes: Asset Count by Type
- Assets by Risk Level
Assets Over Time by Risk Level
Top Locations by Assets
Top 5 Assets by Revealing Hostnames
Top 5 Assets by Risk Level
Distribution of SSL/TLS Versions

assets-risk-levels-widget.statement: The Assets by Risk Level widget uses minimal, low, medium, high and critical levels.

quotes: This widget provides information on how the assets are distributed across different risk levels such as minimal, low, medium, high, and critical.

revealing-hostnames-widget.statement: The Top 5 Assets by Revealing Hostnames widget shows an Impact Level and ranks by highest impact level in decreasing order.

quotes: Impact Level: The impact level of the information revealed in the hostname
The top 5 assets are determined based on the highest level of impact and are listed on a decreasing order of magnitude.

tls-versions-tested.statement: The Assets Overview widget Distribution of SSL/TLS Versions only tests connections for SSL 2.0 and 3.0 and TLS 1.0, 1.1, 1.2 and 1.3.

quotes: Connections are only tested for the following SSL/TLS versions:
SSL Versions: 2.0 and 3.0
TLS Versions: 1.0, 1.1, 1.2, and 1.3
- Distribution of SSL/TLS Versions

top-assets-risk-score.statement: The Top 5 Assets by Risk Level widget shows a risk score computed for the asset based on the findings associated with it.

quotes: Risk Score: A risk score computed for the asset based on the findings that are associated with the asset.
